'''July 2001 Carmel tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in DTC, Carmel, IN on 30 July 2001. [[Justin Stauffer]] won it. It is known from Vince Accetturo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2751">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-31-carmel-in-7-30-01d2751/ carmel-in-7-30-01], DeckTech (Vince "D.Maul" Accetturo, 31 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-31-carmel-in-7-30-01d2751/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 July 2001
* '''Site:''' DTC, Carmel, IN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Stauffer]]
